name: calidad360
description: Calidad 360 Hospitalaria — Sistema de Gestión de Calidad (SGC) ISO 9001

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
